rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a community of people sharing an identity, interest, or purpose, including an online community.

example.english: This community often shares photography tips.
example.traditional: 呢個社群成日分享攝影心得。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 se5 kwan4 sing4 jat6 fan1 hoeng2 sip3 jing2 sam1 dak1

rows.note: Use this for the feeling of belonging to and being connected with a community.

example.english: After joining this group, I finally have a sense of community.
example.traditional: 加入呢個社團之後，我終於有歸屬感。
example.jyutping: gaa1 jap6 ni1 go3 se5 tyun4 zi1 hau6 ngo5 zung1 jyu1 jau5 gwai1 suk6 gam2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on the interests, attitudes, or characteristics that people have in common.

example.english: Although our backgrounds are different, we share a lot of common ground as a community.
example.traditional: 我哋雖然背景唔同，但有好多共同點。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jin4 bui3 ging2 m4 tung4 daan6 jau5 hou2 do1 gung6 tung4 dim2

rows.note: Use this for a commune or an organized collective living arrangement, especially a secular or ideological one.

example.english: This community believes everyone should live and work together.
example.traditional: 呢個公社主張大家一齊生活同工作。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gung1 se5 zyu2 zoeng1 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 sang1 wut6 tung4 gung1 zok3
